# Sawians
Sawians are a group of artificially created species based off of a similar genome, often manning Nanotrasen stations.
While they differ in looks and behaviour, most have certain common traits: - Their extremely fast metabolism makes them great at healing most wounds, though it comes at the cost of highly increased hunger. - They aren't accustomed to wearing clothes. They move faster while naked, but get slower the more things they're wearing. - Their bodies don't respond well to some reagents that would otherwise be beneficial due to their artificial nature.
Sawians of the same species differ very little in terms of personality and looks due to their unique genetic composition. Deviations are mostly a rarity.
Sawians are biologically genderless, though some still sport masculine/feminine features visually.
